title: Deal protocol: selective decryption for private hands
description: Implement card dealing via selective decryption. To deal card C to player P: all OTHER players send their decryption of C to P. P decrypts with their own key last, revealing the plaintext card. P now knows the card; no one else does (they only saw encrypted versions). For face-up community cards: all players decrypt cooperatively, everyone sees the result. Must handle: partial reveals (some cards face-up, some private), mid-game draws from the deck, and discard piles.
close_reason: deal_card_with_keys: chained decryption through all non-recipient keys then recipient. Tests pass.
